card.name: Period ending first warning sentence
card.fires_on: The period closing the opening sentence of a warning or precaution subsection that states a serious adverse reaction occurs with a named drug. The next sentence usually gives details, risk factors or an action.

modes.label: Reaction occurs with drug
modes.description: Period after a sentence saying a serious reaction can occur or has occurred with or after a brand-name drug.

modes.description: Period after a sentence saying events were reported in patients receiving a drug or drug class.

card.writes: It promotes words that begin an elaboration, such as 'especially' and 'notamment', so the next sentence adds detail or emphasis.
card.plain: It marks the end of the first sentence of a drug warning, where details about who is affected or what to watch for come next.
